Your usual step count

Compare your steps with recent days on the same weekday, at the same time. A quieter day is simply a quieter day.

The pale line after “Now” shows your usual pattern for the rest of the day. It isn’t a forecast or a target.

The sun shows how today compares at that same time. Its colour stays warm, even on quieter days.

This prototype uses illustrated hourly patterns and sample totals, not live health data. Today is captured at 19:00; earlier dates show complete days. A real account would need enough history before showing a usual pattern.
